title: Web Clips
description: Puts a website shortcut on the Home Screen (iOS) or in the Dock (macOS).

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: The PNG icon to show on the Home Screen. If not set, the system displays a white square. For best results, provide a square image that's no larger than 400 x 400 pixels and less than 1 MB when uncompressed. The graphics file is automatically scaled and cropped to fit, if necessary, and converted to PNG format. Web clip icons are 144 x 144 pixels for iPad devices with a Retina display, and 114 x 114 pixels for iPhone devices. To prevent the device from adding a shine to the image, set Precomposed to true.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: The name of the web clip that the system displays on the Home Screen.

URL.title: URL
URL.description: The URL of the web clip.
